rootCause.summary: resolveGoverningProvision fell back to CONFIRMED_OPERATIVE on baseDocumentId when no OPERATIVE_AUTHORITY_CONFIRMED governing restatement existed, but only surfaced REVIEW_REQUIRED successors when predecessorDocumentId was non-null. AutoNation Fifth A&R has predecessorDocumentId=null (Fourth A&R absent), so REVIEW_REQUIRED was ignored and doc-a was falsely confirmed; summarizeBundleProductionAuthority then reported allProvisionsProductionActive=true.
rootCause.category: lost identity binding / provisional-edge / null-predecessor handling
